The '''Stensen's Colony system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stensen's Colony]].
